item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Scholz resisted a specific allied, proxy, or domestic proliferation push in a concrete negotiation. I also did not find evidence that he used proliferation arguments opportunistically for short-term political gain. The available record is mostly principled rhetoric: support for arms control, warnings about proliferation, and a preference for multilateral institutions, alongside continued NATO deterrence. Confidence is moderate because the evidence is clear on his stated posture but thin on a direct case of resisting a proliferator.","evidence":[{"title":"The Federal Chancellor’s 2024 summer press conference “I look forward to your questions”","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"24 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040","summary":"Scholz said long-range U.S. weapons were being stationed in Germany to protect Germany and NATO states and to prevent war, and added that Russia had massively violated past arms-control agreements while “we all wish to live in a world where arms control plays an important role again.” This is the clearest 1B.6 evidence: he frames security policy as compatible with arms control, not as a substitute for it.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Speech by Olaf Scholz at \"Summit of the Future Global Call\"","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"12 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/speech-chancellor-summit-of-the-future-global-call-2308462","summary":"Scholz explicitly said nuclear proliferation poses growing threats and framed the international order in terms of peace, stability, and multilateral repair. This is strong evidence of nonproliferation-minded good faith.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.2","1B.4"]},{"title":"Speech by Olaf Scholz, Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany at the reception on the occasion of the Summit of the Future","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"23 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/speech-by-olaf-scholz-chancellor-of-the-federal-republic-of-germany-at-the-reception-on-the-occasion-of-the-summit-of-the-future-new-york-23-september-2024-2310980","summary":"Scholz celebrated renewed commitment to the UN Charter, international law, and institutional reform of the international system. This is indirect but relevant evidence that he backed de-escalatory multilateral structures rather than proliferation incentives.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.4"]},{"title":"Federal Chancellor Scholz’ press conference at the NATO Summit","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"11 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/pc-chancellor-nato-summit-2298906","summary":"Scholz emphasized NATO deterrence and alliance security rather than arms-control diplomacy.
